title: Is anyone marketing their games or is it just a hobby?
author: FoxExeYt
selftext: Curious if any AI game devs are genuinely trying to get their game out there or its more jsut fun things to do

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body: Marketing costs money and we are gamedevs, not marketeers.

comments.author: RUSuper
comments.body: I'm just doing it as a hobby, but putting updates here weekly which allows me to get the feel for how much people like it and it should become something more than just a hobby.

comments.author: johnesco
comments.body:
I've tinkered with code a long time. Marketing felt like a step I'd never reach. I started vibe coding and suddenly ideas I'd had, but couldn't quite code, started to come to life. More of a dream-come-true than a hobby. But perhaps the start of one? After making a few trivial things I sat down and focused on one game and giving it as much polish as I could. For years I've worked as a QA tester for games and done some web design, but usually they only wanted "does it work as designed" because the design was considered "done". Now with my own game, I can be, "huh, I don't like that, let's change it" mixed with 45 years of playing video games myself from Pong to Persona. I like being able to put my experience and design into something that's so new and still changing.

But if I keep polishing it, and playtest, and optimize? I'd like to get that point, and then seriously consider if anything I can make this way is work marketing.

comments.author: APK223311
comments.body:
I do other stuff with AI to begin with, I saw other project like gaming, coding, done with AI as well and I’ve put remaining credits on this now cuz I know what a game should look like (my perspective) and I wanna try it out. 

If I make something good, I’d definitely try to put it out there.

comments.author: Robonotes1760
comments.body: Just a hobby for me. I only ever work on open source games.

comments.author: timcorin
comments.body: I’m about to launch some games/physics toys on iOS. First one in review. I have vibecoded and entire marketing strategy tool to help me. Because I’m useless at social media. So yes, I will be trying to get the out there!

comments.author: Shalke97
comments.body: Hobby, but with some success. 1000 Units Sold so far. Grim Reach Idle on steam

comments.author: Important_Citron_340
comments.body: I'll wait until the anti AI mob calms down

comments.author: politicalmasochist96
comments.body: i plan to market what im creating, release to steam and see how it goes

comments.author: Bhodar
comments.body: Hobby with irregular posts on FB.

comments.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
comments.body:
I run a marketing business for a living. I will say I’m lucky because 99% of the people I see building don’t understand real marketing.

That being said, 99% of the AI apps I see aren’t worth marketing. I’ve seen a lot of pretty looking front ends. A fully developed game with structure and long term plans is more rare.

comments.author: KnownPride
comments.body:
I will just focus on gameplay and fun factor till i satisfied.  
Than after that maybe i will start promoting it.

comments.author: PakMan105
comments.body: Honestly I think it depends on the goal. if its a hobby, people post and move on. if they want a real traction, they probably need to do proper market research beforehand. Analytics tools can help with that side, like Games-Stats
